name: Supply and Demand
summary: Drizzlik, a leathercrafter in Booty Bay, claims to be the finest in the South Seas. Director Riddlevox of the Tinkers' Union has placed an order for twelve Excelsior-line boots, and Drizzlik needs skins from crocolisks by the northern Stranglethorn river to start shaping them.

sections.title: An Order from the Tinkers' Union
sections.body: Drizzlik brags that this leatherwork is famed everywhere as exquisite, a connoisseur's choice. The latest order comes from Director Riddlevox, the Tinkers' Union's chief inventor, who wants a dozen of the Excelsior-line boots he favors, among Drizzlik's best sellers. To begin shaping them, Drizzlik needs skins from the crocolisks by the northern Stranglethorn river. The equipment stands ready, and leaving so important a customer unsatisfied would be a poor idea.

sections.title: Once the Skins Arrive
sections.body: Drizzlik finds the skins good enough. How fine they are matters little, since they will form the inner layer of the boots, though they must still be comfortable. Skins that prove too stiff can be softened with tiger blood, one of the tricks of the trade.

faq.answer: Drizzlik is a leathercrafter in Booty Bay who boasts of being the finest in the South Seas and beyond.
Director Riddlevox, the Tinkers' Union's chief inventor, ordered twelve Excelsior-line boots.

faq.q: Where are the crocolisks found for this commission?
aliases: where do i find the skins
faq.answer: Drizzlik points to the northern Stranglethorn river, where the crocolisks live.

faq.q: How many skins does Drizzlik want?
